/byang chub sras po dam pa la/ /ji ltar dbang ni bskur ba ltar/ /de bzhin gsang ba'i byang sems kyis/ /da lta khyed la dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ gu ru ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya bho dhi tsit+ta a mṛ te sarba pañtsa a bhi ṣ-iñtsa hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ dwangs ma'i lam rtsa dbu ma mthing la dmar ba spu gu can na mar song bas bde stong gi ye shes skyes par sgom du bcug cing*/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then cing steng rlung cung zad mnan la dar cig sgom du bcug pa'i ngang la ngo sprad de/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /bde dang stong pa dbyer med pa/ /de nyid ltos dang ngos gzung med/ /rang bzhin lhan cig skyes pa'i ngang*/ /thams cad ro mnyam bde chen no/ /kye rigs kyi bu sems kyi rnam rtog kun dang bral zhing bde stong ngos gzung las 'das pa'i ngang 'di sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i dbang dam pa yin gyis ngos zung zhig ces brjod do/ /gsum pa rjes dam tshig 'bogs pa ni/ kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyi/ / gsang ba'i dam tshig chen po ni/ /ye shes sgrub rdzas bdud rtsi lnga/ /dmar chen ga bur tsan dan sbyar/ /rdo rje chu yi kun tu bsre/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun mthun mtshungs/ /'di dang 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga/ /rgyun du yang dang yang du brten/ /'di ni dam tshig bla na med/ /ma nyams skal ldan khyod kyis srungs/ / zhes dkrol nas kyang legs par dpog go /de nas kye rigs kyi bu/ ngag gi sgrib pa thams cad dag cing ngag nus pa dang ldan par 'gyur ba yin gyis/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga brten pa dang*/ gtum mo tsaṇa ḍa li sgoms shig /sa dgu pa man chad dang skal ba mnyam zhing*/ rgyas pa'i 'phrin las chen po 'grub la mthar thug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur sangs rgya ba yin no/ /zhes brjod la tshogs kyi dga' ba bya'o/ /bzhi pa yid kyi sgrib pa sbyong zhing*/ bde ba chen po'i skur grol ba shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la'ang*/

sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor de'i nub phyogs su gung la phyag rgya mtshan ldan nam yid rig mos pas/ slob ma la dbang bskur te/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas slob ma rnams mgrin gcig tu/ kye kye bcom ldan bde chen chos kyi dbyings/ /rnal 'byor rdo rje mi phyed bdag/ yang dag phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor las ni byung*/ /bdag nyid chen po kun bdag nyid/ /mnga' dbang bdag la de nyid stsol/ /nyon mongs 'khor ba'i 'dam du ni/ /byings pa'i skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /zhes pa gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ /bla mas kye ma gsang ba shes rab ye shes kyi/ /dam tshig bsrung bya sems la chongs/ /bud med mi spang dang du blang*/ /tshangs spyod don la gnas par bya/ /yon tan thams cad 'di las 'byung*/ /'di spangs bde ba'i dngos grub med/ /nyams pa mkha' 'gro'i chad pa yis/ /tshe 'phos dmyal ba dag tu ltung*/ /zhes pa gsum gyis dam tshig byin la/ de'i don slob mas khas blang ba ni/ /shi'am srog la babs gyur kyang*/ /bya dga' chen po nyid byung yang*/ / dam tshig bka' las 'da' mi byed/ /sa ma ya na ra kan/ zhes pa gsum brjod nas/ bla ma la dngos sam yid kyis phyag dang bskor ba byas la/ bla ma yi dam gyi lhar gsal bas slob ma la gdong g.yogs bcings te/ ye shes pa dbab pa ni/ dpon slob kun rdo rje phag mor bsgoms pa'i bla ma'i thugs ka nas phag mo mang po spros te/ slob ma'i snying nang du thim par bsgom du bcug nas bla mas/ rdo rje phag mo bde gshegs yum/ /nyung 'bru tsam du gsal ba la/ /bde bas mi bzod gar byed pa/ /ba spu'i bu ga kun tu gang*/ / yang yang sgoms shig rigs kyi bu/ /zhes brjod la gdong g.yogs bkrol te/ yum la dngos sam yid kyis phyag dang bskor ba byas la/ bla mas/ 'o rigs kyi bu yum gyi bha ga ni sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i pho brang chen po ste/

klong gsal las/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*/ /bha ga'i dbyings nas rang byung ste/ /chos rnams kun gyi 'byung gnas nyid/ /bha ga gsang sngags kun gyi gnas/ /bde chen ye shes 'byung gnas yin/ /'di nyid ma brten thabs gzhan med/ /thabs kyi rgyud kyis grol ba yin/ /bde chen 'di brten bde ba thob/ /yang dag sangs rgyas 'di las byung*/ /zhes pas gsang sngags kyi chos thams cad 'dir 'dus par gsungs shing*/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyang lam 'di la brten nas sangs rgyas/ 'phral gyi bde skyid thams cad kyang 'di las 'byung bas yum gyi bha ga 'di la khyod kyis mchod par gyis shig /bud med tsam la khro ba spongs/ /mtshan ldan yum la gus par gyis/ /tshe gcig sangs rgyas bde ba ni/ /'dis ster nus kyis gzhan gyis min/ /bud med brnyas shing mkha' la gshe/ /bde dang bral nas na rag spyod/ /de bas rtag tu gus par gyis/ /zhes brjod la/ phyag 'tshal me tog gtor nas/ yum des 'di skad brjod do/ /hūm̐ nga yi bha ga gsang chen 'di/ /gang zhig mos pas sus brten pa/ /yon tan dngos grub thams cad 'byung*/ /bde stong mchog gi dngos grub thob/ /oṃ gu ru ḍā ki ni ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya añdza li hoḥs bha ga cung zad bstan nas/ bla mas phyag rgya'i srin lag g.yon pa bzung nas slob ma la gtad pa ni/ hūṃ ye shes lha mo bde ba'i sku/ / kun tu bde ba'i gnas sbyin ma/ /dga' bas gzugs mdzes yid 'ong ma/ / rtag tu gus pas mchod par gyis/ /ā+oṃ ma hā su ka hoḥ zhes pas slob ma'i lag tu gtad nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ yang brjod pa/ kye ma las ldan rigs kyi bu/ khyod nyid pad+ma he ru ka /rta mgrin dbang gi sku ru sgoms/ /yum ni rdo rje phag mor bskyed/ /gnyis ka'i phung khams skye mched rnams/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gror gsol btab nas/ /bdag dang yum gyi mkha' gsang ni/ /rdo rje pad+mar byin gyis rlobs/

/de'ang skad cig dran rdzogs su rigs kyi bu nyid rta mgrin dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i spyi bor pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du/ pad+ma thod phreng mthing nag rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa bde chen 'khor lor ra las rdo rje mkha' 'gro dkar po/ mgrin par tsa las rin chen mkha' 'gro ser po/ snying gar āḥlas chos dbyings mkha' 'gro mthing ga/ lte bar hrī las pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar po/ gsang bar ya las las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gur gsal ba'i lha thams cad gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i gsang bar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa khong seng can hūṃ gis mtshan pa'o/ /lha mo nyid rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ gcer bu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i spyi bor pad zla dang nyi ma'i steng du mkhar chen bza' 'tsho rgyal dmar po/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ bde chen 'khor lor ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ mgrin par ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ /snying gar ma las chos dbyings mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga /lte bar ni las pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ gsang bar sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang gu /thams cad kyang gtso mo dang phyag mtshan mthun pa'i bha ga pad+ma dmar po 'dab bzhi'i dbus su zla gam la phaṭa ser po bsgoms la phan tshun snyoms par zhugs shing*/ kye skal ldan/ yum gyir pad+mar dal gyis bcings/ /'o bya lus sems bde ba bskyed/ /bde la sems bzung dal bus bsrubs/ /byang sems 'chor ba snyam byed na/ /me tog stong pa'i rgya yis gdab/ /stong par yal dus bsrubs pa yis/ /yang yang bde ba spar bar bya/ /bde stong gnyis med don de la/ /der 'dzin ma byed ngo la ltos/ /gnyis shor gnyis mnyam dus 'di ru/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'char/ /de ni ngo yis zin par bya/ /de ltar lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba spyi bo nas g.yo ba la ltos shig

/bde stong spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes 'di nyid dga' ba'i ye shes so/ /mgrin par dngas ma cher babs pa'i ye shes la bltas pas rnam par mi rtog pa ni mchog dga'i ye shes so/ /snying gar babs pa ni dga' bral gyi ye shes so/ /gsang bar babs dus phra rags kyi rnam rtog kun 'gags nas snang srid bde ba chen por shar la gnyis 'dzin gyi rnam rtog phra rags mtha' dag dang bral ba ni lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba gnyug ma'i ye shes so/ /'di nyid kyi ngang la 'og rlung drag tu 'then la dar cig mnyam par zhog cig /yang bskyod pa dang bsrubs pas bde ba spar ba'i ngang la der 'dzin gyi rnam rtog dang bral bas cher gyis ltos la mnyam par zhog cig /da ni gsang ba nas lte bar bzlog la de nyid kyi ngang la zhog cig /de bzhin du snying ga dang mgrin pa dang spyi bor byang sems skya nar gyis bzlog la gang yang yid la mi byed pa gdod ma'i ka dag gi ngang du lhod kyis mnyam par zhog cig /ces ngos ma zin gyi bar bskyar zhing ngo sprad la mthong ba brgyud pa'i rim pas dbab bzlog dgram pa'i lta stangs dang 'khrul 'khor la slob cing sbyong ngo*/ /gsum pa rjes ni/ bla mas yang brjod pa/ kye ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /des ni dag bya gang dag na/ /nyon mongs yid kyi sgrib pa dag /yid ni mthu dang ldan par 'gyur/ /las kyi phyag rgya brtan par dbang*/ /skal ba sa bcu dag dang mnyam/ /phrin las dbang gi las rnams 'grub/ /'bras bu skye med chos sku thob/ /ces brjod la/ tshogs kyi dga' ba rgya chen po bya'o/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang rgya cher bshad pa'o/ /lnga pa lus ngag yid gsum du 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa kun sbyong zhing chos sku rdzogs pa chen po'i zab don mthar thug pa tshig dbang rin po che la/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba'i steng du me long la chos 'byung gnyis brtsegs kyi dbus su mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi rtsa sngags dang*/

mtha' skor la rig 'dzin gyi mtshan bris la/ kha dgab/ phyi nang gi tshogs mchod rgya cher bshams la bzhag /yang na dkyil 'khor gyi byang du me tog tshom bu bkod la/ /der bzhag cing*/ bde ba'i phyag rgya ma de nyid dang slob ma kun byang du 'khod la/ maṇ+ḍal phul te gsol ba gdab pa ni/ /kye kye dus gsum bla ma rje/ /yang dag ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /rig pa'i ngo bo ye shes la/ /bdag nyid nges pa'i shes pa skyes/ /gnyis med ye shes mchog 'di nyid/ /'gro gzhan dag la yod pa min/ /dam chos bdud rtsi'i mchog 'di nyid/ /'thung phyir bdag nyid bla ma la/ /gus pa'i yid kyis gsol ba 'debs/ /gal te don thal bdag gis 'tshal/ /rnam pa kun tu mchog gyur pa'i/ /bzhi pa'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol/ /zhes pa gsum gyi rjes la bla ma yi dam du gsal ba'i ngang nas dkyil 'khor ram tshom bu'i dbus su dkyil 'khor gyi lha bskyed/ mtshams su yab yum bskyed do/ /de'ang dbus su rdo rje phag mo yab yum la/ /mtshams bzhir rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro yab yum bskyed nas ye shes pa dgug la yi ge gsum gyis rgyas gdab cing*/ bla ma yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi bla ma yi dam gyi lha tshogs rnams bdud rtsi'i rnam par byon nas thod pa'i bdud rtsi la thim par bsam zhing*/ tshom bu'i lha tshogs la mchod bstod byas pas 'od du zhu nas rang gi snying gar thim/ thugs ka nas 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros pas thams cad las mchod pa'i lha mo lngar gyur te/ nam mkha' khyab par gang nas mchod sprin sna tshogs thogs te/ me long gi chos 'byung gi dbus su rdo rje phag mo yab yum dang*/ mtha' bskor du bla ma brgyud pa bskyed pa la mchod nas/ dgyes te snyoms par zhugs pa'i bdud rtsi babs pas thod pa gang zhing bdud rtsis bla ma yi dam la mchod la/ tshogs dbul zhing brgyud pa'i bla ma la gsol ba btab nas/

dam tshig sbyin pa ni/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥ bsrung du med pa'i dam tshig ni/ /thams cad ro mnyam chos nyid dang*/ / 'khor 'das spang blang bral ba yi/ /gang shar chos nyid rol pa la/ /ma rig 'dzin pas ma bslad srungs/ /'das na 'khor ldog na ra kan/ /zhes brjod nas/ slob ma rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pa'i smin phrag tu g.yung drung dmar po zhig g.yon du myur bar 'khor bar dmigs te/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro sprin phung gtibs pa tsam spyan drangs la bstim zhing rol mo'i sgra bsgrags pa'i rjes la/ dngos gzhi ni/ 'o rigs kyi bu dar cig glod la bcos bslad med pa'i shes pa rang sar zhog cig

/shes pa bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'bol le/ /shig ge /lhaud de ba/ skye med spros pa dang bral ba ston ka'i nam mkha' rnam par dag pa'i dkyil lta bu 'di nyid gnyug ma lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po ye ji bzhin pa'i gnas lugs yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig /ces brjod la/ slob ma rnams langs te phyogs bzhi'i nam mkha' la rim gyis blta bcug nas bla mas brjod pa/ kye ma kye ma rigs kyi bu/ mig rtse nam mkha'i shar du ltos/ /shar gyi bar snang dag la ni/ /thogs pa med par 'gro bar sgoms/ / kye ma kye ma rigs kyi bu/ /mig rtse nam mkha'i lho ru ltos/ /lho yi bar snang dag la ni/ /thogs pa med par 'gro bar sgoms/ /kye ma kye ma rigs kyi bu/ /mig rtse nam mkha'i nub tu ltos/ /nub kyi bar snang dag la ni/ /thogs pa med par 'gro bar sgoms/ /kye ma kye ma rigs kyi bu/ /mig rtse nam mkha'i byang du ltos/ /byang gi bar snang dag la ni/ /thogs pa med par 'gro bar sgoms/ /'gro bar bsams na 'gro mkhan med/ /gang du 'gro bsam phyin pa med/ /'gro bar bsam pa rang gi sems/ /sems ni mtha' bral stong pa yin/ /zhes brjod nas yang*/ kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ /sems ni dang po gang nas byung*/ /rgyu rkyen ci las byung bar ltos/ /zhes pas ma rnyed pa'i tshe/ yang brjod pa/ kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod nyon/ /rtsa ba bral ba'i sems nyid la/ /gdod nas ma skyes dngos po med/ kha dog dbyibs med ngos gzung med/ /gang nas ma byung song ba med/ /da lta mi gnas rgyu rkyen med/ /'di nyid sems kyi gnas lugs te/ /brjod du med par shes par gyis/ /zhes brjod pa'i don bshad la/ /yang nam mkha'i dkyil na rigs lnga'i sku gzugs bsgom du bcug la bla mas brjod pa/ /kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyi/ /rgyal ba'i sku gzugs 'di la ltos/ /rgyan dang cha lugs du mar snang*/

/snang bar 'dzin pa rang gi sems/ /de la ltos dang gzhi rtsa bral/ /de bzhin yid yul snang ba'i gzugs/ /yul nyid gsal la mkhan pos stong*/ /de ni gsal stong chos sku yin/ /zhes brjod nas/ dbyug pa ring po la dril bu'i phreng ba brgyus la/ sa la dbyug pa'i rtsa ba brdung zhing brjod pa/ kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ /'di yi sgra ni snyan mi snyan/ /legs par thos sam ngo bor ltos/ /sgra ru 'dzin pa rang gi sems/ /sems ni grags stong chos kyi sgra/ /de la ltos dang gzhi rtsa bral/ /de bzhin sgra ru grags pa kun/ /sna tshogs thos kyang ngo bos stong*/ /gsal por grags kyang rang bzhin stong*/ /shar dus gzhi med rtsa ba bral/ /ngo bo ngos gzung ma rnyed pa/ /de ni grags stong bya ba yin/ /zhes pa dang yang*/ spos dang sman la sogs pa'i dri snom du bcug la/ kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ /spos dang sman sogs dri zhim dang*/ /de bzhin mi zhim dri rnams la/ /dga' dang mi dga' skyes pa'i tshe/ /rang gi sems la tshur ltos dang*/ / gang las byung zhing gang du song*/ /de yi ngo bo ci 'dra zhig /dgag sgrub sems kyi ngo bor ltos/ /de ni rkyen snang shes pa ste/ /gnyis 'dzin shes pa glo bur yin/ /rkyen phyir snang yang ngo bos stong*/ /zhes brjod nas/ yang ro mngar skyur myong du bcug la/ /kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ /bza' btung ro mchog myong bar gyis/ /mngar skyur lan tshwa tsha kha bska/ /ro drug myong ba'i mkhan por ltos/ /bltas pas mi rnyed skye ba med/ /mtha' bral dbu ma spros bral dang*/ / rang grol chos skur shes par mdzod/ /yang phrag pa'i gos phud la reg bya 'jam rtsub reg tu bcug nas brjod pa/ kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod la/ /reg la dgag sgrub skyes pa'i sems/ /de la gnyis 'dzin gang skyes kyang*/ /rnam pa gsal la rang bzhin stong*/ /rang gi sems su shes par gyis/ /sems ni stong gsal chos sku'i ngang*/

/gdod nas rtsa ba bral ba yin/ /zhes brjod nas yang*/ skyid sdug dga' mi dga' chags sdang la sogs pa sgoms shig byas la/ brjod pa/ kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod kyis/ /rang gi sems la phar ltos dang*/ / skyid sdug dgag sgrub cir snang yang*/ /snang mkhan sems la tshur ltos dang*/ / dga' dang mi dga' sems las byung*/ /bde dang sdug bsngal gang byung yang*/ /gsal la ngo bo rig stong yin/ /dper na chu zla ji bzhin no/ /zhes pa dang*/ yang dug lnga dug gsum rang ga ma'i sems skyer bcug la/ brjod pa/ kye ma rigs kyi bu khyod la/ /dug lnga dug gsum ci skyes kyang*/ /me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /sems la snang yang ngos gzung med/ /nyon mongs gzhi med rtsa ba bral/ kha dog dbyibs med ngos gzung med/ /gdod nas ma skyes chos sku yin/ /nyon mongs rtog pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /sems las shar zhing sems la nub/ /skyes dang grol mnyam rba rlabs bzhin/ /rags dang phra ba'i rnam rtog kun/ /der 'dzin med par rang sar zhi/ /de ltar rang bzhin ma grub pa/ /nyon mongs rtog pa'i mtshams rtogs na/ /gnyen po spang blang med par grol/ /ces ngo sprad do/ /gsum pa rjes ni bla mas/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bus/ /stong gsal chos sku'i dbang thob pa/ /des ni dag bya gang dag na/ /lus ngag yid gsum 'dzin sgrib dag /gsum ka nus pa tshad du phyin/ /brten bya bde sdug spang blang bral/ /rjes su dbyer med bsgom par dbang*/ /sa ni bcu gcig kun tu 'od/ /'phrin las bzhi po mngon du gyur/ /'bras bu sku lnga lhun gyis grub/ /ces brjod la tshogs kyi dga' ba bya'o/ /drug pa sems nyid kyi ngo sprad pa bla ma'i dbang ka dag rtsal dbang la sngon 'gro snod sbyong zhing byin gyis brlabs pa/ dngos gzhi bcud blugs te smin grol la dgod pa/ rjes spro dga' bskyed de gzengs bstod pa gsum las/ dang po ni khregs chod kyi sngon 'gror bskur ba ste/

pad 'dab brgyad 'od ra dang rdo ra me ri bris la/ de'i steng du thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba bzhag /phyi nang gi mchod pas bskor la/ thod pa'i dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po la/ o rgyan yab yum rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha dad med pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku za 'og gi 'jol ber sha ba'i snyan zhwa thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba dang gri gug 'dzin pa'i sku dkar ser zhal sbyor du bsgoms pa'i/ mdun du rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ g.yas su rin chen mkha' 'gro/ rgyab tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ g.yon du las kyi mkha' 'gro/ steng du chos sku kun bzang yab yum la sogs pa brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor/ de dag gi mtha' skor rnams su dpa' bo dpa' mo/ bka' srung dam can rnams bskyed nas ye shes pa bstim/ mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/ phyag dang bskangs kyi rjes la/ bdag dang mtha' yas sems can rnams zhes pa la sogs pas sems bskyed nas/ gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye kye bla ma rnams kyis bdag smin par mdzad du gsol/ rig pa rtsal gyi dbang bka' rab 'byams bskur du gsol/ bdag grol bar mdzad du gsol/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol/ zhes pa lan gsum brjod do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la kun 'dus spyir bskur ba dang*/ mtshan brgyad bye brag tu bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni bla ma rnams byon nas rang la thim par bsgom du bcug la/ ā+oṃ gu ru kun bzang yab yum/ rigs lnga yab yum/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ dga' rab rdo rje/ shrī sidha/ pad+ma mtshan brgyad/ ye shes 'tsho rgyal/ pad+ma las 'brel rtsal/ sa ma ya dzaḥzhes brjod do/ /slob ma rnams langs te thal mo spyi bor sbyar la rlung kha sbyor bzung zhing bla mas/ 'o khyod rnams ma yengs par nyon cig /rang gi lus 'di tha mal pa shin tu mdzes shing lang tsho rgyas pa/ lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i snying nang du ā+oṃ dkar po zla ba'i steng na yod pa 'khor ba la sems zung zhig

/yang 'og min dang phyogs bcu'i zhing nas sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa sprin phung gtibs pa bzh-in byon nas snying nang gi ā+oṃ la thim par bsgoms shig /ces brjod nas rol mo'i sgra cher byas la/ yang snying nang nas nyi ma'i steng du āḥdamar po 'khor bar dmigs la/ nam mkha' nas mar rdo rje phag mo la rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba byon nas āḥl thim par sgoms shig /ces brjod la rol mo bsgrag go /yang snying gi nang du nyi zla'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga yod pa drag tu 'khor bar dmigs la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma chos sku kun bzang yab yum dang gnyis su med pa la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba spyan drangs pa byon nas hūm̐ la thim par sgoms shig /ces brjod la spos dang tshil chen gyis bdug cing rol mo'i sgra cher bya'o/ /gnyis pa la sku lnga lhun grub tu dbang bskur ba/ /sku gsum bde chen du dbang bskur ba/ thig le nyag gcig tu dbang bskur ba gsum las/ dang po ni/ yang slob ma rnams langs te thal mo sbyar ba'i tshe/ bla mas/ kye rigs kyi bu rnams skad cig gis stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma zla ba dang*/ nyi ma'i steng du rang nyid pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo gcer bu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i 'khor lo lngar/ ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrī:aḥrnams pad+ma dang zla nyi'i steng na rang bzhin gyis bskor bar bsams la/ yang chos kyi dbyings spros pa med pa'i pho brang nas bla ma seṅge sgra sgrogs yab yum gnyis med chos sku'i rang bzhin mthing ga rgyan drug dang bcas pa la bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba byon nas snying ga'i hūṃ la thim par sgoms shig /ces brjod la rol mo bsgrag go /de bzhin du 'og min nas pad+ma rgyal po yab yum longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba ser po mgrin pa'i trāṃ la thim par sgoms shig /ces rol mo bsgrag

/o rgyan nas blo ldan mchog sred yab yum cir yang sprul pa'i sku brgyud pa'i bla ma dang bcas pa lte ba'i hrīḥl thim par sgoms shig /ces dang rol mo bsgrag /lho nub rnga yab kyi gling na pad+ma sam bha wa mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku yum dang bcas pa ljang gu brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba bde skyong 'khor lo'i āḥl thim par sgoms shig /ces dang rol mo bsgrag /rdo rje gdan nas shākya seṅge mngon par byang chub pa'i sku yum dang bcas pa dkar ser brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba byon nas spyi bo'i ā+oṃ la thim par sgoms shig /ces rol mo cher bsgrag go /gnyis pa ni yang*/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro bsams pa'i spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ snying ga gsum du pad zla nyi ma'i steng du/ ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsam pa 'khor zhing*/ sku'i bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas dkar po yum dang bcas pa la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba spyi bo'i steng gi nam mkha' la byon nas bzhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas lus thams cad gang*/ zag med kyi bde ba rgyas shing slar spyi bo'i ā+oṃ la thim/ gsung gi bla ma nyi ma'i 'od zer dmar po yum dang bcas pa la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor ba byon nas sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi babs pas gsung gi dngos grub thob cing lus gang*/ slar mgrin pa'i āḥ la thim/ thugs kyi bla ma pad+ma thod phreng mthing nag yum dang bcas pa la brgyud pa'i bla mas bskor bar byon nas sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi babs pas thugs kyi dngos grub thob cing lus thams cad gang nas bde ba rgyas pa'i mthar snying ga'i hūṃ las thim par bsam zhing*/ gu gul dang spos dang tshil chen gyi dud pa rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pa cher bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ thams cad gral la 'khod pa rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas lus sems khong glod de thod pa nas dngos grub kyi rten bdud rts-i re blud la/ bla mas/

e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu/ /ngang dngas rang bzhin bdag nyid che/ /rab 'byams rig pa'i dbang bskur nyon/ /da lta shes pa rang sor zhog /bcos bslad ma byed lhod kyis glod/ /sems kyi 'phro 'du lings kyis bsgyur/ /rbad kyis chod la phyam gyis zhog /sems nyid ma skyes gnyug ma'i don/ /rang bzhag yongs grol nam mkha' 'dra/ /ye nas ma skyes gdod ma'i ngang*/ /bsam med ye nas rdzogs pa che/ /'du 'bral med pa'i chos nyid do/ /zhes ngo sprad la/ sems nyid stong pa chos kyi sku/ /thig le nyag gcig tu gting thag bcad do/ /gsum pa rjes spro dga' bskyed cing gzengs bstod pa ni/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la bla ma thams cad kyi byin rlabs zhugs pas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba phun sum tshogs shing yid la bsam pa thams cad rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa yin no/ /zhes brjod nas tshogs kyi dga' ba rgya cher bya'o/ /bdun pa ye shes kyi gsang sgo dbye ba rig pa rtsal gyi dbang ni/ thod rgal gyi sngon 'gror bskur ba las 'di la yang*/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang gsum las/ dang po ni shom ra bla ma'i dbang ltar bshams la/ slob ma rnams gral la 'khod nas sems bskyed do/ /gnyis pa ni rang gi spyi bor pad+ma 'dab bzhi dkar po'i dbus su/ ā+oṃ dkar po las 'od 'phros rang lus ā+oṃ du gyur pa las 'od 'phros snang srid thams cad ā+oṃ du gyur nas bdag gzhan thams cad kyi lus kyi sgrib pa dag / sku'i dbang dang dngos grub thob par bsam la/ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ ā+oṃ/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so/ /yang mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi'i dbus su/ āḥdamar po las 'od 'phros rang lus ār gyur pa las 'od 'phros snang srid thams cad ā'i rang bzhin du gyur bdag gzhan thams cad kyi ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsung gi dbang dang dngos grub thob bar bsam la/ ā ā ā zhes dbyangs dang bcas pas brgya rtsa gcig brjod do/

/yang snying gar pad+ma sngon po 'dab bzhi'i dbus su hūṃ mthing ga las 'od 'phros rang lus hūm̐ du gyur pa las 'od 'phros snang srid thams cad hūm̐ du gyur nas bdag gzhan thams cad kyi yid kyi sgrib pa dag /thugs kyi dbang dang dngos grub thob par bsam la/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes brgya rtsa gcig brjod do/ /yang lte bar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus su trāṃ ser po las 'od 'phros rang gi lus traṃ du gyur pa las snang srid thams cad la 'od zer phog pas trāṃ du gyur nas/ bdag gzhan thams cad kyi nga rgyal gyi sgrib pa dag /yon tan gyi dbang dang dngos grub thob par bsams la trāṃ trāṃ trāṃ zhes brgya rtsa gcig brjod do/ /yang gsang bar pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus su phaṭa ljang gu las 'od 'phros rang gi lus phaṭa du gyur pa las 'od 'phros snang srid thams cad phaṭa du gyur pas bdag gzhan thams cad kyi phrag dog gi sgrib pa dag /phrin las kyi dbang dang dngos grub thob par bsams la phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ces brgya rtsa gcig brjod do/ /de ni yi ge 'khor lo'i dbang ste rtsa lam byang nas 'od gsal 'char sla ba'o/ /de nas thod pa nas bdud rtsi byin nas sems spro bsdu med par bzhag pas/ rig pa rang dngas la rtsal mi 'gag pa ni rang byung gi rig pa'i don gyi rtsal dbang yin no zhes ngo sprad do/ /de ni rang byung rig pa'i rtsal dbang ngo*/ /de nas lhun grub rig pa'i rtsal dbang ni mngon sum ngo sprad la theb par gdab bo/ /gsum pa rjes ni tshogs kyi dga' ba bkra shis dang bcas pa bya'o/ / brgyad pa byin rlabs mthar phyin pa mkha' 'gro don gyi dbang la gsum las/ sngon 'gro ni dbang khrid rgyab chos dang bcas pa tshar la khad pa'i zhag tha ma'i sngar nub shom ra snga mar ltar bshams la/ don dam pa'i sems bskyed nas langs te thal mo sbyar ba la bla mas/ pad+ma rak+ta dang sin+dhu ra'i thig le'i smin mtshams su bkod la/

'o do nub mkha' 'gro don gyi dbang bgyid pas ma yengs par nyon cig ces brjod do/ /dngos gzhi khyad par can du sgrub pa ste/ 'dir rang gi lus dpa' bo rta mgrin dang*/ /rdo rje phag mo 'khril sbyor gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa'i spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum sum brgya drug cu 'khrab pa las 'od 'phros pas/ shar phyogs kyi nam mkha'i dkyil na tshur rdo rje mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas pheṃ pheṃ hriṃ yom yom zhes brjod cing byon nas spyi bor thim par sgoms shig

/ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya badz+rā ḍā ki ni sa ma ya dza dzaḥ de bzhin du mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum bcu drug gar byed pa'i 'od kyis lho phyogs nas rin chen rigs kyi dpa' bo yab yum byon nas mgrin par thim/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥ ma ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya rat+na ḍā ki ni sa ma ya dza dzaḥ/ snying gar chos kyi dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum sum cu rtsa gnyis 'khrab pa'i 'od zer gyis steng gi nam mkha' nas mar sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa byon nas snying gar thim par sgoms shig /ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya bhud+dha ḍā ki ni sa ma ya dza dza ཿ lte bar pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum drug cu rtsa bzhi dga' bas lang long ban bun du 'phyo ba'i 'od zer gyis/ nub phyogs nas pad+ma mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa byon nas lte bar thim par sgoms shig /ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya pad+ma ḍā ki ni sa ma ya dza dzaḥ gsang bar las kyi mkha' 'gro nyi shu rtsa brgyad gar mdzad pa'i 'od zer gyis byang phyogs kyi nam mkha' nas tshur sna tshogs mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa byon nas gsang bar thim par sgoms shig /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya karma ḍā ki ni sa ma ya dza dzaḥ/ gzhan yang phyi nang gi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro til gyi gong bu kha bye ba lta bu rnams char bzhin du babs pas lus kyi phyi nang dang ba spu'i khung bu thams cad du sib sib thim par sgoms shig /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ hriṃ maṃ pheṃ pheṃ yo ma ha ho hūm̐ hūm̐ sa ma ya dza dzaḥ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod la tshil chen gyi dud pa 'thul zhing*/ thod rnga dang rkang gling dang*/ rol mo'i sgra skad cher bya'o/ /de dag ni bskyed rim gyi don dbang ngo*/ /rdzogs rim gyi don dbang ni/ bdud rtsi byin nas/ rang rig dngas phyin par glod pa'i ngang la ngo sprad de/

rang rig stong pa dang*/ gsal ba dang*/ ris mnyam pa dang*/ so sor ma 'dres la mi rtog pa dang*/ rang grol ba rnams chos dbyings mkha' 'gro/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro /rin chen mkha' 'gro/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro/ las kyi mkha' 'gro dang lngar ngo sprad do/ /rjes ni tshogs kyi dga' ba rgya cher bya'o/ /gsum pa rjes gzhan don bka' rgya dang bcas pa la/ gzhan ba'*/ gtad rgya/ bka' bsgo dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ dbang khrid rgyab chos dang bcas pa tshar ba'i nub mo gzhan don 'grub pa rnams la gnang ba sbyin pa ni/ tshogs mchod la sogs sngar ltar bshams la bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol ba btab nas/ rig 'dzin gyi gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag la/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'gro ba dpag tu med pa la zab mo'i dbang bskur chos shod/ byams pa dang snying rjes 'gro ba'i don rgya cher mdzod cig ces lan gsum bya'o/ /rjes tshogs kyi 'khor los dga' bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni slob ma mchog gi bka' srol rnams chig brgyud du bzung nas 'jig rten na yun du gnas pas 'gro ba'i don rgya cher 'byung bas/ de'ang bla ma la sangs rgyas su mthong zhing gdams pa la yid ches skyes nas shes rab dang snying rjer ldan zhing gzhan don 'grub pa la bya ste/ bdud rtsi'i thig le gnas gsum du byas la/ 'khor lo lngar rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang*/ mkha' 'gro lnga bskyed la steng dang phyogs bzhi nas bla ma thams cad dang rnam snang sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la spyi bor thim pas sku'i 'gro don phyogs med du 'grub bar bsam zhing*/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru (< a > sid+dhi ) si ti pha la ha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes brjod/ de bzhin du bla ma dang snang mtha' pad+ma mkha' 'gro mgrin par thim pas gsung gi 'gro don 'grub/ bla ma dang mi bskyod pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro snying gar thim thugs kyi 'gro don 'grub/ bla ma dang rin 'byung rin chen mkha' 'gro lte bar thim/

yon tan gyi 'gro don 'grub/ bla ma dang don grub las kyi mkha' 'gro gsang bar thim phrin las kyi 'gro don 'grub/ bla ma dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor char bzhin babs pas lus kyi phyi nang kun tu thim/ 'gro don mthar rgyas par bsam la/ sku rten zhi khro'i thang ka /gsung gi rten snying tig gi glegs bam/ /thugs kyi rten rdo rje sems dpa'i me long rnams gnas gsum du bzhag cing*/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gsang ba chen po mkha' 'gro snying tig gi bstan pa gtad pa yin pas/ khyod kyis tshe 'di'i 'dod pa dang grags pa la ma blta bar rang don gyi 'khri ba dang dbral bas/ skal ldan gzhan la zab mo'i gdams pa ci nus su ston la/ bka' rgyas btab nas phyi ma'i tshe skal pa dang ldan pa gcig la bstan pa rgya cher gtod cig /rang yang nyams su longs la gzhan don phun sum tshogs par mdzod cig /ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru (< a > sid+dha ི) si ti pha la ha ri ni sa puṣ+ti ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes brjod la maṇ+ḍal steng gi bdud rtsi byin nas/ bkra shis rgyas par brjod do/ /rjes gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul la tshogs kyi 'khor los dka' ba rgya cher bya'o/ /hūṃḥ gsum pa ni gzhan don la spro ba'i snying rje can de'i bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir bka' bsgo bya ba ni/ bka' srung gi dpal gtor mgo thog tu bzhag la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyis ji ltar bka' bsgos shing dam la gnas pas bar chad dang dngos grub phrog par byed pa'i dgra bgegs ma rungs pa rnams mngon spyod kyi las mdzad pa'i dpal mgon dam pa chos skyong ba'i bsrungs ma thams cad dang*/ khyad par du dpal sngags kyi bdag mo srog sgrub ma/ gza'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa/ mkha' 'gro snying tig gi gter srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ rigs kyi bu skal ba bzang po 'di la 'go zhing stongs grogs rgya chen po mdzad pas bcol ba'i 'phrin las thams cad lhun gyis grub par mdzod cig

/ces lan gsum brjod la tshogs kyi dga' ba dang*/ glu gar bzang po dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgya cher brjod do/ /'di ni shin tu gnyan pas legs par brtags la bka' bsgo byed pa yin no/ /dpe 'di nyid chig brgyud ma gtogs pa las tshang bar mi sbyin zhing dbang chog rnams la'ang bum pa gsang ba shes rab ye shes tshig dbang rtsal dbang rnams phyogs cig tu bris te spel zhing*/ /gzhan rnams phyogs gcig tu byas te gsang zhing sbas la skal ldan gcig la tshang bar byin no/ /dge ba 'di yis srid pa'i sems can kun/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog tu rab zhugs te/ /ma lus phyam cig thams cad byang chub nas/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub par shog /gangs ri thod dkar rin chen snying po'i mgul/ /o rgyan rdzong zhes bya ba'i gnas mchog tu/ /rin chen dbang gi phreng ba 'dir bkod pas/ /phyi rabs skal ldan tshogs rnams dga' bar mdzod/ /rin chen dbang gi phreng ba zhes bya ba/ /gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul du me tog dang 'bras bu smin pa'i ston ka'i tshe pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis bkod pa rdzogs so/ /maṅgalaṃ/ /bha wan+tu// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (6)rin po che dbang gi phreng ba/ -PAGE 390--PAGE 461--PAGE 389-
